SELECT fcf.form_index , fcf.form_name , fcf.form_id , fcf.form_index , fcf.form_file_name , fcm.default_selection_yn FROM fta_coo_forms_mapping fcm INNER JOIN fta_coo_forms fcf ON fcf.form_id = fcm.form_id AND #{issue_date} BETWEEN fcf.start_date AND COALESCE(fcf.end_date, '99991231') WHERE fcm.fta_code = COALESCE(#{fta_code}, 'KOREA')
AND fcf.form_name NOT LIKE '%소명서%'
ORDER BY fcm.sort_no
